restriction: Retains all specified finite-law, causal-model, moment, score, maximizing-branch, OLS and same-mean derivative facts. The square-link family is fitted as a working model without requiring correct conditional-mean specification. At a = 1/16 and epsilon = 0, the true probabilities at X = -1, 0, 1 are 5/16, 1/8, 5/16, while the likelihood maximizer fits 1/4. Omits a refutation of Appendix C's first-order scaling assertion under its correctly specified conditional-probability model reading; the derivative discrepancy concerns population expected-likelihood projections allowing misspecification.
